description: This file is a CMake script defining functions and macros for integrating Google Protocol Buffers into a Caffe2-based project. It manages finding the protobuf library, configuring build options, setting up protoc generation for C++ and Python, and handling platform-specific build settings with custom logic for cross-compilation scenarios.

methods.name: custom_protobuf_find
methods.description: Defines a macro to locate and configure the protobuf library, handling options like shared/static libs, version checks, and platform-specific quirks.

methods.name: caffe2_protobuf_generate_cpp_py
methods.description: Generates C++ and Python protobuf source files from .proto definitions, managing protoc invocation and output paths, including support for building protobuf as a local subproject.
